WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt

items.oldQuestion: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
items.newQuestion: 2018年有订单且2017年同月也有订单的各个月份，订单量相比2017年同月增加多少笔？只输出月份编号和增加笔数。
items.oldGoldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cur.mo AS month,
       cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change
FROM monthly cur
JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017
WHERE cur.yr = 2018
ORDER BY cur.mo;
items.newGoldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cur.mo AS month,
       cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change
FROM monthly cur
JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017
WHERE cur.yr = 2018
ORDER BY cur.mo;
